Results.ReviewText: Assembly was pretty straight forward.  Took about 2.5 hours.  A lot of pieces which looked overwhelming, but every piece fit as it should.  Works well. Heats evenly.  The cover is really nice as well and does cover the wheels.  The only downfall is that it has folding sides which is fine, but if you need to move it you need to use the left side to lift it up to move, therefore unhinging it making it difficult to move.  But once moved, just fold it back into place.  Not a deal breaker since how often will you be moving your grill.  The super nice perk which I'm sure was noted but did not see in the ad, is that where you attach your propane tank also acts as a scale to determine how much propane is left in the tank.
Results.Title: Nice Grill

Results.ReviewText: Weber hasn't forgotten the importance of manufacturing a quality product and they haven't forgotten what customer service is about. My grill was experiencing normal wear and tear and I went to Home Depot to replace parts. The sales rep told me I could replae them at nost with a phone call to Weber. The Weber agent was extremely helpful and took me through  the process. In less than a week I had the parts and a grill functioning like new. The grill is terrific, and because of the quality of it and the way I was treated, I would never entertain purchasing a competitive product.
Results.Title: Quality service  from a quality Company

Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill to replace the smaller Weber Portable Gas Grill that I used for the last 18 years.  The difference is that my wife feels comfortable to operate this one and that is a bonus for me.  It works fine.  Heats up quick and cooks nice.  I hope to have this on for at least 18 years too!  I bought this at ACE Hardware and as an ACE Rewards Member they assembled and delivered it for free (an $80 savings).  At this point the grill is still brand new and I am very happy.  The only thing I wish Weber would fix is a bigger tray for the drippings.  This is the same size tray that was on my portable weber.  The current tray is about 1 inch deep and needs to be at least 3 inches deep.  They could easily offer a larger tray that could bolt into the same area.  There is plenty of room for a deeper tray.
Results.Title: Very Good Value for the Money

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
